enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active learning will preferentially add solves where the current winner demonstrably errs, accelerating RMSE reduction compared with blind dataset regeneration or further tuning.

diagnosis: The run is sample-bottlenecked with persistent, input-correlated residual structure (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) while validation noise is low, so errors are driven by under-covered/weak regions rather than tuning.
